env._comment_RETENTION_2026_09_18: USER-2026-09-18 retention policy (supersedes RAILWAY-500MB-FIX 4h/30min): candle_micro (pair OHLC) kept 12 HOURS; signal_log kept NEWEST 200 ROWS PER PAIR (count-based, core/retention.py — this is the signal-history ledger the pre-signal history gate verifies against); EVERY other table kept 60 MINUTES. Volume math: ~29 pairs x 200 rows ≈ 6k rows ≈ 9-12 MB + 12h candles ≈ 80 MB — safely inside the 500 MB free-plan volume with the soft/hard watchdog still active.
env._comment_SIGNAL_HISTORY_GATE_2026_09_18: SIGNAL-HISTORY-GATE (core/signal_history_gate.py) — USER-2026-09-18 directive: before ANY signal is provided, analyse the pair's signal history (200-row ledger) + cross-pair fleet data. Pairs with shrunk WR < 46% floor (n>=20), 6-loss streaks, broken CALL/PUT directions (<42%, n>=15), or far-below-fleet-median WR (−8pp) are suppressed to NEUTRAL; verified-good pairs (n>=50, WR >= break-even) get a confidence boost; signals opposing the cross-pair currency consensus get a soft penalty. Monitor live: GET /api/history-gate. QX_PAIR_HEALTH_GATE=1 activates the 8-consecutive-loss 30-min cooldown (record_trade_outcome now wired in feed.py). Set QX_HISTORY_GATE=0 to restore unconditional every-candle mode.
env._comment_CONFLUENCE_V1_2026_09_02: CONFLUENCE-V1 engine — strict high-confidence mode. Signals are published ONLY when >=3 independent strategy clusters agree with ZERO opposition, the position (regime/range-location/HTF) agrees, and honest confidence >= 65. There are NO fallback signals. LIVE re-eval and the strength gate are PERMANENTLY disabled in code (no env override) — a published signal is immutable for its whole candle.
env._comment_LEGACY_FLAGS: Legacy suppression flags from the old every-candle engine. They are inert under CONFLUENCE-V1 (the old blender fallbacks were deleted) and kept only so unrelated deploy tooling does not break on unknown vars.
env._comment_PHASE_3_FIX_2026_08_13: API key system — public read is enabled by default (anyone with URL can view signals). Set QX_PUBLIC_READ=0 to require API key for all reads.

QX_TOKEN.description: Quotex ssid token (extract from browser DevTools). Required for live data — sim mode is permanently disabled.

_notes_CONFLUENCE_V1_2026_09_02: Complete prediction-engine replacement (audit-driven). WHY SIGNALS WERE WRONG: (1) two fallback layers manufactured CALL/PUT with zero edge when no module fired (~41.9% WR); (2) 'confluence' counted correlated group names — one hammer at support produced 5 'agreeing groups' from the same wick geometry; (3) the final calibration remapped ALL confidences into a meaningless 47-68% band; (4) WEAK + single-group signals (~47% WR) were allowed by default. THE FIX: engines/base/confluence.py — 6 independent evidence clusters (TREND/MOMENTUM/MEANREV/LEVEL/PATTERN/MICRO), each module collapsed to one net vote; publish only on >=3 cluster agreement + zero opposition + position awareness (trend=with-trend only, range=fade-at-extreme only, volatile=never) + HTF non-opposition + noise gate + honest confidence (55 + 7/extra cluster + score quality + alignment bonuses, cap 92). WIN-RATE INTEGRITY: unified rule WR = correct/(correct+wrong) everywhere (draws excluded); /api/winrate now allowlist-filtered; pair_hourly_patterns dedup ledger (last_ctime) stops re-grade double counting; retention 7 -> 90 days so 30d/all-time windows are real; stats module-vote dedup; confidence buckets numerically sorted. NO OVERWRITE: DISABLE_LIVE_REEVAL=True and strength gate off permanently in code. Backtest: synthetic trend_up 88.9% WR (n=18), trend_down 83.3% (n=6), range=abstains, zero errors over 777 candles. Verify battery: scripts/verify_confluence_engine.py (45/45 checks).
_notes_PHASE_3_FIX_2026_08_13: API key system added: (1) core/api_keys.py — SQLite-backed key storage with SHA-256 hashing. (2) FastAPI middleware classifies every request as public_read / api_key_write / admin / unknown and enforces auth policy. (3) Endpoints: GET/POST /api/keys (admin), DELETE /api/keys/{id} (admin), GET /api/keys/verify (public). (4) Public read endpoints (signals, pairs, history, stats) are accessible WITHOUT any auth per user requirement 'যে কেউ দেখতে পারবে'. (5) API keys are optional, for programmatic clients. (6) Admin PIN (existing) still guards token-management endpoints.
_notes_RAILWAY_500MB_FIX_2026_09_17: RAILWAY-500MB-FIX: the free-plan 500 MB Volume filled (~150 MB/day growth from candle_micro.ticks_json + signal_log + votes under the old 90-day/6h retention) and every SQLite write failed with SQLITE_FULL -> crash-loop. New policy (core/retention.py, started from db.init() on every boot): pair OHLC (candle_micro) kept 4 h; ALL other data kept 30 min; pass every 60 s; PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) + conditional VACUUM return freed pages to the Volume; backups 8->2 every 30 min; storage watchdog at 350 MB soft / 450 MB hard force-prunes. Bounded state tables (model_registry/api_keys/agent_models/algorithm_state/_meta) are never time-pruned - they cannot grow. Backtest: scripts/verify_retention_policy.py + scripts/verify_ms_latency.py. Live monitor: GET /api/latency.
_notes_SIGNAL_HISTORY_GATE_2026_09_18: SIGNAL-HISTORY-GATE — the USER-2026-09-18 directive that supersedes the 2026-09-09/14 every-candle-on-every-pair mode: 'যেকোন সিগন্যাল প্রধান করার পূর্বে, ওই সিগন্যাল হিস্টোরি গুলো বা অন্যন্য ডেটা গুলো যদি এনালাইসিস করে তারপর সিগন্যাল প্রোভাইড করবে। এক পেয়ার এর ডেটা অন্য পেয়ার এর সাথে মিলিয়ে দেখবে। কোন পেয়ার এ সঠিক সিগন্যাল বেশি দিচ্ছে, সেই গুলো ভালোভাবে যাচাই করে সিগন্যাল প্রধান করবে।' Measured on live production data 2026-09-18 (108 OTC + 39 real graded signals): overall WR 50.9% (< 54.05% OTC break-even), confluence_v1_any 50.5% (coin flip), worst pairs NZDUSD_otc 16.7% / USDPHP_otc / BRLUSD_otc / USDZAR_otc 33.3%, direction failures NZDUSD_otc PUT 0% (n=4). ROOT CAUSES FIXED: (1) 30-min retention starved every learning mechanism — signal_log now keeps newest 200 rows per pair + candle_micro 12h + other data 60 min (core/retention.py); (2) no pre-emission history verification — new core/signal_history_gate.py wired in engines/__init__.py BEFORE any signal is provided (learning mode < 20 samples; 6-loss streak cooldown; shrunk-WR pair floor 46%; per-direction floor 42%/n>=15; fleet-relative suppression 8pp below median; cross-pair currency-consensus penalty; verified-good boost), feed.py ML fallback no longer resurrects suppressed signals (_history_gate_suppressed); (3) pair_health.record_trade_outcome never called — now wired after every grade + QX_PAIR_HEALTH_GATE=1; (4) module_votes parser only accepted the legacy '→ CALL' arrow format while the blender writes arrow-less '[module] CALL net=' — parser fixed, module learning loop revived; (5) signal_verifier layer5 used a nonexistent QX_DB_PATH env — now uses db.DB_PATH. Verify battery: scripts/verify_history_gate.py + scripts/backtest_history_gate.py (walk-forward on the 147 live signals + synthetic fleet stress test).
_notes_PERSISTENT_VOLUME_REQUIRED: CRITICAL: Railway does NOT persist the filesystem by default. Every redeploy wipes signals.db, losing ALL signal history. BOTH steps required: (1) Railway dashboard -> Settings -> Volumes -> Add Volume, Mount Path '/app/data'. (2) DB_PATH is set to '/app/data/signals.db' in this env block. Check boot logs for the db.py persistence marker — boot_count > 1 confirms the volume is real.
_notes_TELEGRAM_ALERTS_OPTIONAL: Optional: set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in Railway Variables (not committed here) to get a Telegram message the moment the Quotex token dies or the feed goes stale, and again when it recovers -- see alerts.py and .env.example.
